title: Never Lose Fido Again With This On-Sale Fi Pet Tracker
gist: Fi is running a Black Friday sale through December 1 at roughly half off its Fi Mini and Series 3+ GPS pet trackers; the piece highlights pet wearables converging with human health-tracker features and the $299 Fi Ultra using T-Mobile's T-Satellite with Starlink for off-grid coverage.

insights.claim: Fi's Black Friday sale through December 1 cuts the Fi Mini from $99 to $50 and the Fi Series 3+ from $129 to $65, roughly half off.
insights.speaker: Molly Higgins
insights.so_what: Deep 50% discounts on pet-tracker hardware suggest a subscription/app-led model where hardware is a customer-acquisition tool.
insights.locator: now’s a great time to try for less

insights.claim: Fi pet trackers work like human health wearables, tracking activity and sleep and alerting owners to pattern changes that can be early signs of health issues.
insights.speaker: Molly Higgins
insights.so_what: Pet tech is borrowing the human wearable health-monitoring playbook, widening the addressable market for health-sensing hardware.
insights.locator: Fi devices help you keep an eye on your pet’s health

insights.claim: The $299 Fi Ultra GPS dog collar uses T-Mobile's T-Satellite with Starlink to track dogs beyond traditional cellular coverage, but requires charging every one to two days.
insights.speaker: Molly Higgins
insights.so_what: An example of direct-to-device satellite connectivity reaching consumer IoT niches — a demand signal for T-Mobile/Starlink D2D services.
insights.locator: Best for Outdoor, Adventure, and Working Dogs
